title: Wear OS DigitalStyle watchface time is missing minutes
symptom: On the latest 3.0.0.2 dev k build 49163c43d, the digitalstyle watch face seems to have font issues (too big when set to AM/PM vs 24 hr) or missing info in the time.
cause: The hourString function in DateUtil.kt uses format "hha" which includes the AM/PM marker, causing the time display to be too big or missing minutes in AM/PM mode.
fix: Change the format string in hourString from "hha" to "hh" when not in 24-hour format.
